6. Disable browser extensions—especially ad blockers or privacy tools—temporarily.
7. Check that the workbook is not open/locked, password-protected, unusually large, or stored only as an online placeholder. Save a local copy first.
8. If necessary, export the relevant worksheet as `.csv` and attach that instead.

Don’t paste confidential workbook data directly into the chat unless you’re comfortable doing so. Once the attachment appears with a visible filename, send the message and I can proceed.
